svg.title: Job flow
svg.desc: Job states and the SQS retry and dead-letter lane.
svg.text: States are written conditionally, so a duplicate delivery cannot move a job backwards.
transient error: message returns after 30 s x 2^n (max 900 s)
redrive (only when the cause was retries_exhausted)
infrastructure error: back to the queue after the delay
redrive: native SQS redrive moves the messages back
Business failures consume the message and end the job; only infrastructure failures reach the DLQ (ADR 0004).
